**Risk flags:**
- Revenue fell 20.7% YoY  
- Single shareholder holds 100.0%

**Overview:**  
Teguh Cahaya Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating in the healthcare sector, specifically community pharmacy and dietary supplements, based in Kuala Lumpur. It was incorporated on 9 April 1991 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 5,000,000. The firm is wholly owned by a single shareholder who holds 100 % of the equity. Reported revenues have declined from RM 40,017,040 to RM 26,191,548 across the three most recent periods, while equity has remained around RM 18–19 million. No legal cases are recorded.
